mapper.select: select user_id from sys_user where user_id=#{id} for update
select hex(payload_hash) from p_inbox where consumer_name='voice-attempt-fact' and event_id=#{event}
select status from p_call_record where account_id=#{account} and operation_key=concat('tts-attempt:',#{attempt}) and fact_kind='ATTEMPT' for update

select concat(account_id,':',voice_task_id,':',voice_service_id,':',provider_code,':',model_id,':',coalesce(application_id,0),':',coalesce(session_id,0),':',coalesce(turn_id,0),':',coalesce(logical_operation_key,'')) from p_call_record where operation_key=concat('tts-attempt:',#{attempt}) for update
mapper.insert: insert into p_call_record(id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,operation_key,capability,billing_owner,status,application_id,session_id,turn_id,provider_code,model_id,provider_request_id,usage_available,cost_source,error_code,finished_at,fact_kind,voice_task_id,voice_attempt_id,logical_operation_key,voice_service_id) values(uuid_short(),utc_timestamp(3),utc_timestamp(3),#{f.accountId},concat('tts-attempt:',#{f.attemptId}),'TTS','NONE',#{f.status},#{f.applicationId},#{f.sessionId},#{f.turnId},#{f.providerType},#{f.modelId},#{f.providerRequestId},0,#{f.costSource},#{f.errorCode},utc_timestamp(3),'ATTEMPT',#{f.taskId},#{f.attemptId},#{f.logicalOperationKey},#{f.serviceId}) on duplicate key update status=values(status),provider_request_id=coalesce(values(provider_request_id),provider_request_id),cost_source=values(cost_source),error_code=values(error_code),updated_at=utc_timestamp(3)
